    D

    DEFAULT_CLEANUP_ELEMS_TABLES_ON_STARTUP - Static variable in class oracle.nosql.valkey.RedisServerConfig
    Default value determining whether, on Valkey api proxy startup, to run a background cleanup thread that will check for and purge any abandoned collection element data that was left due to previous abnormal termination.
    DEFAULT_HOST - Static variable in class oracle.nosql.valkey.RedisServerConfig
    Default hostname used to listen for client connections.
    DEFAULT_MAX_ATOMIC_RETRIES - Static variable in class oracle.nosql.valkey.RedisServerConfig
    Default limit on the number of retries of certain operations if version mismatch is detected due to concurrent operation on the same key.
    DEFAULT_PORT - Static variable in class oracle.nosql.valkey.RedisServerConfig
    Default port used to listen for client connections, same value as in Redis Server.
    DEFAULT_TABLE_LIMITS - Static variable in class oracle.nosql.valkey.RedisServerConfig
    Default table limits used to create main Redis table.
